def extractOldExprVars (expr : Expression.Expr)
  : List Expression.Ident := match expr with
  | .const _ _ | .bvar _ _ | .fvar _ _ _ | .op _ _ _ => []
  | .abs _ _ e => extractOldExprVars e
  | .quant _ _ _ tr e => extractOldExprVars tr ++ extractOldExprVars e
  | .app _ e1 e2 => match e1, e2 with
    | .op _ (CoreIdent.unres "old") _, .fvar _ v _ => [v]
    | .op _ (CoreIdent.unres "old") _, _ => panic! s!"Old expression {expr} not normalized"
    | e1', e2' => extractOldExprVars e1' ++ extractOldExprVars e2'
  | .ite _ c t e => extractOldExprVars c ++ extractOldExprVars t ++ extractOldExprVars e
  | .eq _ e1 e2 => extractOldExprVars e1 ++ extractOldExprVars e2

/--
Substitute `old(var)` in expression `e` with `s`.
-/
def substOld (var : Expression.Ident) (s e : Expression.Expr) :
  Expression.Expr :=
  match e with
  | .const _ _ | .fvar _ _ _ | .bvar _ _ | .op _ _ _ => e
  | .abs m ty e' => .abs m ty (substOld var s e')
  | .quant m qk ty tr' e' => .quant m qk ty (substOld var s tr') (substOld var s e')
  | .app m e1 e2 =>
    match e1, e2 with
    | .op _ (CoreIdent.unres "old") _, .fvar _ x _ =>
      -- NOTE: We rely on the typeChecker to normalize `e` ensure that `old` is
      -- only used with an `fvar`.
      if x == var
        -- substitute, if should be substituted
        then s
        else e
    | _, _ => .app m (substOld var s e1) (substOld var s e2)
  | .ite m c t f => .ite m (substOld var s c)
                      (substOld var s t) (substOld var s f)
  | .eq m e1 e2 => .eq m (substOld var s e1) (substOld var s e2)

/--
For each `(var, val)` in `sm`, substitute `old(var)` in expression `e` with
`val`.
-/
def substsOldExpr (sm : Map Expression.Ident Expression.Expr) (e : Expression.Expr)
  : Expression.Expr :=
  if sm.isEmpty then e else
  match e with
  | .const _ _ | .fvar _ _ _ | .bvar _ _ | .op _ _ _ => e
  | .abs m ty e' => .abs m ty (substsOldExpr sm e')
  | .quant m qk ty tr' e' => .quant m qk ty (substsOldExpr sm tr') (substsOldExpr sm e')
  | .app m e1 e2 =>
    match e1, e2 with
    | .op _ (CoreIdent.unres "old") _, .fvar _ x _ =>
      match sm.find? x with
      | some s => s
      | none => e
    | _, _ => .app m (substsOldExpr sm e1) (substsOldExpr sm e2)
  | .ite m c t f => .ite m (substsOldExpr sm c)
                      (substsOldExpr sm t) (substsOldExpr sm f)
  | .eq m e1 e2 => .eq m (substsOldExpr sm e1) (substsOldExpr sm e2)

/--
For each `(var, val)` in `sm`, substitute `old(var)` in each expression `es`
with `val`.
-/
def substsOldExprs (sm : Map Expression.Ident Expression.Expr) (es : List Expression.Expr) :=
  es.map $ substsOldExpr sm

theorem substsOldExpr_singleton: substsOldExpr [(var,s)] e = substOld var s e := by
  induction e <;> simp [substsOldExpr, substOld, Map.isEmpty, *]
  split <;> simp_all;

import Strata.DL.Imperative.PureExpr

namespace Imperative

/-! # Pure Expression Variable Lookup : HasVarsPure -/

class HasVarsPure (P : PureExpr) (α : Type) where
  getVars : α → List P.Ident

/-! # Imperative Variable Lookup : HasVarsImp -/

class HasVarsImp (P : PureExpr) (α : Type) where
  definedVars : α → List P.Ident
  modifiedVars : α → List P.Ident
  touchedVars : α → List P.Ident
          := λ e ↦ definedVars e ++ modifiedVars e

---------------------------------------------------------------------

/-! # Procedure Aware Variable Lookup : HasVarsTrans -/

/--
  Extends HasVarsImp, but transitively look up on the procedures
  `modifiedVarsTrans` differs from `modifiedVars` by taking a procedure lookup function
  Note: This is still not fully transitive, in the sense that if the procedure body contains call statement,
  the procedures associated with those call statements won't be looked up.
  The problem with fully transitive lookup is that it does not guarantee termination.
  E.g. mutually recursive procedure calls
-/
class HasVarsTrans
  (P : PureExpr) (α : Type) (PT : Type)
  where
  definedVarsTrans : (String → Option PT) → α → List P.Ident
  modifiedVarsTrans : (String → Option PT) → α → List P.Ident
  getVarsTrans : (String → Option PT) → α → List P.Ident
  touchedVarsTrans : (String → Option PT) → α → List P.Ident
  allVarsTrans : (String → Option PT) → α → List P.Ident
  := λ π a ↦ modifiedVarsTrans π a ++ getVarsTrans π a

abbrev HasVarsProcTrans (P : PureExpr) (PT : Type) := HasVarsTrans P PT PT

end Imperative

    (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression) post ++ [h1]) := by
  have merge : ∀ {α : Type} {a b c d t : List α}, a ⊆ c ++ t → b ⊆ d ++ t →
      (a ++ b).Subset (c ++ (d ++ t)) := by
    intro α a b c d t H1 H2 y hy
    simp only [List.mem_append] at hy ⊢
    rcases hy with hy | hy
    · rcases List.mem_append.mp (H1 hy) with h | h
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inl h)
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr h)
    · rcases List.mem_append.mp (H2 hy) with h | h
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inl h)
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr h)
  induction post with
  | const _ _ | bvar _ _ | op _ _ _ =>
      simp [substOld, Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars]
  | fvar _ _ _ =>
      simp only [substOld, Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars]
      intro y hy

  | abs _ _ _ ih => exact ih

        · simp only [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars]
          intro y hy
          exact hy

open OldExpressions in
theorem substOldPostSubset:
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression)
    (substOld h2 (Lambda.LExpr.fvar m h1 ty) post)).Subset
    (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression) post ++ [h1]) := by
  have merge : ∀ {α : Type} {a b c d t : List α}, a ⊆ c ++ t → b ⊆ d ++ t →
      (a ++ b).Subset (c ++ (d ++ t)) := by
    intro α a b c d t H1 H2 y hy
    simp only [List.mem_append] at hy ⊢
    rcases hy with hy | hy
    · rcases List.mem_append.mp (H1 hy) with h | h
      · exact Or.inl h
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr h)
    · rcases List.mem_append.mp (H2 hy) with h | h
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inl h)
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr h)
  induction post with
  | const _ _ | bvar _ _ | op _ _ _ =>
      simp [substOld, Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars]
  | fvar _ _ _ =>
      simp only [substOld, Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars]
      intro y hy
      exact List.mem_append.mpr (Or.inl hy)
  | abs _ _ _ ih => exact ih
  | quant _ _ _ _ _ ih1 ih2 =>
      simp only [substOld, Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars] at ih1 ih2 ⊢
      exact merge ih1 ih2
  | ite _ _ _ _ ihc iht ihf =>
      simp only [substOld, Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars] at ihc iht ihf ⊢
      exact merge ihc (merge iht ihf)
  | eq _ _ _ ih1 ih2 =>
      simp only [substOld, Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars] at ih1 ih2 ⊢
      exact merge ih1 ih2
  | app _ _ _ ih1 ih2 =>
      simp only [substOld]
      split
      · split
        · intro y hy
          simp_all [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars]
        · intro y hy
          simp_all [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars]
      · simp only [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars] at ih1 ih2 ⊢
        exact merge ih1 ih2
